_about: My validity review (manual) of every scenario Qwen's writer got accepted in runs/gen_02, in the format of autogen_02/eval/phase4_review.json: a verdict per scenario (valid, weak but valid, flawed, invalid) and per near miss, under the PI's criteria of 2026-09-28 (a near miss the agent cannot check, or that a natural reading of the request includes, is flawed; ambiguous ones case by case, with the PI's rulings as precedents) and the method's rules (each near miss fails exactly one condition; the target meets all; background records fail at least two; anchors survive; readable through the replica). Read before any solver run of these scenarios. My rulings, for the PI to overrule.

9101.note: Owned by Maya Lopez (shares the first name); fails only c2.

9102.note: Owned by Maya Chen-Lin: the containment form the method recommends; with an exact Maya Chen in the workspace, 'Maya Chen's' does not naturally include her.

9103.family: F0 (labelled; it offers F1, the creator role)
9103.note: Owned by Dana Whitfield, but Maya Chen created it and modified it last. The request's possessive ('Maya Chen's') names no role, so its own naming supports the creator reading as well as the owner's (the AP2-SLK-01 precedent: flawed when the request's naming supports both readings). Its probe is left out; the cover and the fact probe keep it.

G4-BOX-05.note: Target 9100 meets all three conditions; background files each fail two (9104: name and owner; 9105: folder and owner; 9106: name/type and owner). Dates consistent. Fact A:User.name covered validly by 9101 and 9102.

G4-BOX-03.note: Target 4201 meets all five conditions. Background: 4208 (a docx, no link, modified Sept 1) and 4209 (Archive, modified Aug 30) each fail at least two. Weak data, not affecting the facts: every file's version 1 is dated at the file's last modification, not its creation (e.g. 4201 created June 20, its only version dated Sept 18 by Leo Park, uploader Maya Chen). The clock rule gives the tests the written-at moment (2026-09-30), after every date in the data. All three brief facts covered validly.
